description: This file contains functions related to configuring MAPE (Mapping of Address and Port for Encapsulation) in a WAN manager context. It includes system calls for tunnel setup, IP address calculations, and syscfg parameter management, primarily aimed at IPv6 and IPv4 address mapping and tunnel configuration.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanManager_MAPEConfiguration(ipc_map_data_t * dhcp6cMAPEMsgBody,const WANMGR_IPV6_DATA * ipv6Data)
methods.description: Configures MAPE tunnel based on provided DHCPv6 MAP-E message and IPv6 data, including address calculation, tunnel creation, and syscfg updates.

methods.name: INT WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid(CHAR * pdIPv6Prefix,INT v6PrefixLen,INT v4PrefixLen,INT ea_length,USHORT * psidValue,UINT * ipv4IndexValue,UINT * psidLen)
methods.description: Calculates the PSID (Prefix SID) and associated IPv4 suffix from IPv6 prefix and addressing parameters.

methods.name: VOID WanManager_MAPE_ResetSyscfgDefaults(VOID)
methods.description: Unsets relevant syscfg parameters to reset MAPE configuration defaults.

ctags.name: WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid
ctags.signature: (CHAR * pdIPv6Prefix,INT v6PrefixLen,INT v4PrefixLen,INT ea_length,USHORT * psidValue,UINT * ipv4IndexValue,UINT * psidLen)
